event_cn: 股票市场出现大额日内支付或流动性压力。
event_en: A large intraday payment or liquidity stress hits the equity market
mechanism_cn: NSCC 当日流动性需求上升，可向流动性敞口最大的会员及其关联家族追缴补充流动性存款。
mechanism_en: The Corporation’s daily liquidity need rises, so it can call Supplemental Liquidity Deposits from members (and affiliated families) with the largest liquidity exposure
process_cn: NSCC 补充流动性存款。
process_en: NSCC supplemental liquidity deposits
modeled_scope_cn: 最大关联家族流动性敞口转为假设补充存款追缴及未覆盖缺口。
modeled_scope_en: Largest affiliated-family liquidity exposure produces illustrative deposit calls and uncovered gaps.
not_modeled_cn: 未复制Rule 4(A)公式、动态需求、实际SLD通知及真实资源。
not_modeled_en: No Rule 4(A) formula, dynamic needs, actual SLD calls or real resources.
real_data_still_needed: Daily/intraday SLD requirements and collections, largest-member liquidity exposure, expiry/roll events.
real_data_still_needed_cn: 日度/日内 SLD 计算和实缴额、最大会员流动性暴露、到期/展期事件。

status_cn: 本轮：部分机制情景已模拟
event_cn: 结算银行出现运营或信用问题。
event_en: A settling bank has an operational or credit problem
mechanism_cn: 结算银行拒绝或未能通过 Fedwire 支付会员的最终净额，使该会员的 NSCC 资金结算无法按时完成。
mechanism_en: The settling bank refuses or fails to settle a member’s net-net balance over Fedwire, so NSCC money settlement for that member cannot complete on time
process_cn: NSCC 结算银行资金结算。
process_en: NSCC settling-bank money settlement

modeled_scope_en: NSCC-only hypothetical bank mapping and end-day acknowledgement gate
not_modeled_cn: 未复制Fedwire交易；未将DTC结果直接用于NSCC
not_modeled_en: No actual Fedwire transfers; DTC outcomes are not transferred to NSCC
real_data_still_needed: Historical NSCC settling-bank mapping, named failures/refusals, net-net obligations and scheduled/actual completion times.
real_data_still_needed_cn: 历史 NSCC 结算银行映射、具名故障/拒绝支付、净净额义务、应付和实际完成时间。

status_cn: 本轮：部分机制情景已模拟
event_cn: 零售券商倒闭或突然退出。
event_en: A retail broker fails or exits abruptly
mechanism_cn: 大量客户账户须在规定时限内通过 ACATS 自动客户账户转移服务迁移，使账户转移及结算活动集中。
mechanism_en: A wave of customer accounts is moved through the Automated Customer Account Transfer Service (ACATS) within fixed timeframes, concentrating transfer and settlement activity
process_cn: NSCC ACATS 客户账户转移。
process_en: NSCC ACATS customer account transfers
modeled_scope_cn: 券商退出引起的假设账户转移集中到达与处理队列。
modeled_scope_en: Hypothetical broker-exit transfer arrivals and processing queue.
not_modeled_cn: 未复制ACATS真实时限、全部状态、参与者违约后的撤销、账户资产可转移性及券商映射。
not_modeled_en: No actual ACATS deadlines, full state machine, participant-default reversals, asset transferability or broker mapping.
real_data_still_needed: Broker-specific ACATS requests, rejects, completions/reversals and timing; obtain original historical notices and comparable windows.
real_data_still_needed_cn: 失败券商的 ACATS 请求、拒绝、完成/撤销量与时间；补取原始历史通知并比较前后窗口。

event_cn: 回购或证券借贷等证券融资市场承压。
event_en: Securities-financing (repo / stock-loan) markets come under stress
mechanism_cn: SFT 清算服务中经合约更替的证券融资交易重新定价并重新计提保证金，使会员在 SFT 账簿上的抵押品与结算义务剧烈变化。
mechanism_en: Novated Securities Financing Transactions in the SFT clearing service reprice and remargin, so member collateral and settlement obligations on the SFT book move sharply

process_en: NSCC Securities Financing Transaction clearing service

not_modeled_en: No chain-specific state/decision/outcome model in this batch; a generic queue or random labels are not a substitute.
real_data_still_needed: SFT service volumes, positions, repricing, initial/independent amounts and settlement obligations; RDS SFTR reporting totals are not NSCC SFT clearing volumes.
real_data_still_needed_cn: SFT 服务交易量、头寸、重估、Initial/Independent Amount 及结算义务；RDS SFTR 报送总量不是 NSCC SFT 清算量。

status_cn: 本轮：部分机制情景已模拟
event_cn: 货币市场工具发行人或其发行及付款代理出现融资问题。

mechanism_cn: 发行及付款代理无法为当日提示的 MMI 付款作出融资确认，使对应发行人简称下的 MMI 到期和发行结算受阻。
mechanism_en: The issuing and paying agent cannot give the MMI funding acknowledgment for the day’s presentments, so MMI maturity and issuance settlement for that acronym stalls
process_cn: DTC MMI 结算及融资确认。
process_en: DTC MMI settlement (funding acknowledgment)
modeled_scope_cn: 假设IPA对发行人简称的融资确认门控，区分到期与发行指令。
modeled_scope_en: Hypothetical IPA funding acknowledgement by acronym, with separate maturity and issuance instructions.
not_modeled_cn: 未复制MMI优化、PIF、真实IPA融资确认或付款失败频率；融资确认不是实际结算成功的充分条件。
not_modeled_en: No MMI optimization, PIF, real IPA acknowledgements or calibrated failure frequency; acknowledgement is not sufficient for actual settlement success.
real_data_still_needed: Issuer/IPA/acronym mapping, presentments, acknowledgement times/amounts, PIF/optimization status and failed/delayed settlements.
real_data_still_needed_cn: 发行人/IPA/acronym 映射、Presentments、资金确认时间与金额、PIF/优化状态及失败/延迟记录。

event_cn: 全市场中断，例如交易所停市、银行暂停营业或宣布紧急状态。
event_en: Market-wide disruption (exchange halt, banking moratorium, or declared emergency)
mechanism_cn: DTC 启用市场中断或不可抗力相关权限，暂停、延长或修改 DTC 结算义务与时限。
mechanism_en: The Corporation invokes its market-disruption / force-majeure powers to suspend, extend, or modify DTC settlement obligations and timeframes
process_cn: 市场中断下的 DTC 结算时限。
process_en: DTC settlement timeframes under market disruption
not_modeled_cn: 本轮未定义该链的专属状态、决策及业务结果模型；通用队列或随机标签不能代替。
not_modeled_en: No chain-specific state/decision/outcome model in this batch; a generic queue or random labels are not a substitute.
real_data_still_needed: Actual DTC Rule38 invocation, affected obligations, revised cutoffs, backlog and recovery; distinguish market closure from service interruption.
real_data_still_needed_cn: DTC Rule38 实际启用通知、受影响义务、修改时限、积压及恢复；区分市场休市与服务停摆。

status_cn: 本轮：部分机制情景已模拟
event_cn: 监管机构暂停某证券交易，或该证券被发现存在欺诈。
event_en: A regulator halts or suspends trading in a security, or fraud is identified
mechanism_cn: DTC 对该证券实施存入冻结或全面锁定，限制所有参与者对其进行存入或账簿划转服务。
mechanism_en: The Corporation imposes a Deposit Chill or Global Lock, restricting deposits or book-entry services for that security across all participants
process_cn: DTC 存入冻结与全面锁定。
process_en: DTC deposit chills and global locks
modeled_scope_cn: 显式证券级存入冻结仅阻止存入，全面锁定阻止所模拟的存入与划转。
modeled_scope_en: Explicit security-level deposit chill gates deposits; global lock gates modeled deposits and transfers.
not_modeled_cn: 不从停牌自动推断DTC锁定，未识别真实锁定决定或原因。
not_modeled_en: No automatic lock inference from a trading halt; no actual restriction decision or reason identified.
real_data_still_needed: Security/CUSIP-level SEC/FINRA actions, DTC chill/lock start/end and reason codes, and non-locked controls.
real_data_still_needed_cn: 证券/CUSIP 级 SEC/FINRA 动作、DTC Chill/Global Lock 开始/解除时间和原因码，及未被锁定的对照证券。

status_cn: 本轮：部分机制情景已模拟
event_cn: 发行人或过户代理出现转让或登记问题。
event_en: An issuer or transfer agent has transfer or registration problems
mechanism_cn: 在确认证券登记至 DTC 名义持有人之前，DTC 可拒绝记入该证券的存入，从而影响其托管与资产服务。
mechanism_en: The Corporation may decline to credit deposits of that issue until registration into its nominee is confirmed, so custody and asset-servicing of the affected security are disrupted
process_cn: DTC 托管及存入和转让服务。
process_en: DTC custody / deposit and transfer services

modeled_scope_en: Deposit instructions require an explicit hypothetical registration confirmation.
not_modeled_cn: 未建模真实发行人、过户代理及证券权属裁定。
not_modeled_en: No real issuer, transfer agent or ownership determination.
real_data_still_needed: Transfer-agent/issuer events, registration rejects/confirmations, DTC deposit-processing results and affected securities.
real_data_still_needed_cn: 过户代理/发行人事件、证券登记拒绝/确认时间、DTC 存入处理结果和受影响资产。

event_cn: 买方执行机构客户，例如对冲基金，承压或倒闭。
event_en: A buy-side executing-firm customer (for example a hedge fund) comes under stress or fails
mechanism_cn: 提交客户交易的代理清算会员仍须向 FICC 对这些交易负责，使压力集中到该代理会员。
mechanism_en: The Agent Clearing Member that submitted the customer’s trades remains responsible to the Corporation for them, so the stress is concentrated on that agent member
process_cn: GSD 代理清算服务。
process_en: GSD Agent Clearing Service

not_modeled_en: No chain-specific state/decision/outcome model in this batch; a generic queue or random labels are not a substitute.
real_data_still_needed: ACS version/effective dates, executing-client to Agent Clearing Member mapping, client stress and agent obligations/margin.
real_data_still_needed_cn: ACS 服务版本、生效日、执行客户与 Agent Clearing Member 关联、客户压力和代理义务/保证金数据。

event_cn: 实物处理或后台运营中断，例如运营场所事件。
event_en: Physical processing or back-office operations are disrupted (for example a site event)

mechanism_en: Envelope Settlement Service deliveries, money-only charges, and dividend/interest claims back up, delaying associated money settlement
process_cn: NSCC 信封结算服务 ESS。
process_en: NSCC Envelope Settlement Service
not_modeled_cn: 本轮未定义该链的专属状态、决策及业务结果模型；通用队列或随机标签不能代替。
not_modeled_en: No chain-specific state/decision/outcome model in this batch; a generic queue or random labels are not a substitute.
real_data_still_needed: ESS site incidents, daily envelope/claim counts, queues/delays and money-settlement timing.
real_data_still_needed_cn: ESS 运营场所事件、信封/索赔逐日量、排队/延迟与金钱交收时间。

event_cn: 保险公司或退休服务会员承压。
event_en: An insurance carrier or retirement-services member comes under stress
mechanism_cn: 保险与退休解决方案 I&RS 数据及会员间相关付款受干扰，影响年金、寿险和退休产品的结算资金流。
mechanism_en: Insurance & Retirement Solutions (I&RS) data and the related I&RS payments between members are disrupted, affecting that settlement flow for annuities, life insurance and retirement products
process_cn: NSCC 保险与退休解决方案结算。
process_en: NSCC Insurance & Retirement Solutions settlement

not_modeled_en: No chain-specific state/decision/outcome model in this batch; a generic queue or random labels are not a substitute.
real_data_still_needed: I&RS membership-to-insurer mapping, credit events, service messages/payments, rejects/delays and recovery.
real_data_still_needed_cn: I&RS 会员/保险实体映射、信用事件、服务消息/支付量、拒绝/延迟和恢复。

event_cn: 衍生品清算机构或期货经纪商承压。
event_en: A derivatives clearing organization or futures broker comes under stress

mechanism_en: Instructions on swap-margin segregated accounts (pledgee / pledgor access) are disrupted, affecting the collateral held in those segregated accounts

not_modeled_en: No chain-specific state/decision/outcome model in this batch; a generic queue or random labels are not a substitute.
real_data_still_needed: DCO/FCM-to-DTC account roles, pledgee/pledgor instruction/access failures and segregated swap-margin balances.

mechanism_en: Customer-property segregated accounts held under CFTC segregation rules must be moved or protected, concentrating activity on that custody flow
process_cn: DTC 客户财产隔离账户。
process_en: DTC segregated accounts for customer property

not_modeled_en: No chain-specific state/decision/outcome model in this batch; a generic queue or random labels are not a substitute.
real_data_still_needed: FCM-failure to DTC customer-property segregated-account mapping, balances, transfer/protection instructions and timing under the applicable rule version.
